title: (b) ValidateJWTSVID consults live presence state
description:
Layer (b) of the persona-3tly.7 decision, and persona-3tly.6's own proposal taken up unchanged: validation consults live PRESENCE state, so a token whose presence was observably revoked fails validation even though exp has not passed. Departure then lands in an RPC that already exists rather than needing a revocation protocol.

The shape already exists. persona-5s4b.82 made ValidateJWTSVID consult live trust-bundle state rather than a cached key, and hire-grpc/src/service.rs:459-467 records why the signer is deliberately not read there. Same move, one field over.

Reaches any SPIFFE consumer that calls ValidateJWTSVID. Does NOT reach one that self-verifies against the JWKS -- that gap is layer (a)'s job and is why all three layers exist.
acceptance_criteria: A token whose presence was observably revoked fails ValidateJWTSVID before exp; a token whose presence merely decayed is distinguishable from one that was revoked.
